overview: The Akhevan Dais is the ceremonial and political center of Ka Vethan, where Praesertum authority is made manifest.
history: Constructed during the earliest era of Praesertum governance.
Used for lineage rites, decree proclamations, and void‑arcane ceremonies.
Expanded with resonance channels to amplify ritual authority.
Became the focal point of Akhevan civic gatherings.
Modern Dais remains the most symbolically powerful site in Ka Vethan.
hooks: A Praesertum decree is about to be announced.
A resonance channel destabilizes during a ceremony.
An Akhevan lineage ritual requires external assistance.
A political faction attempts to influence the Dais proceedings.
